description: This file defines the AgentEventStore class, which manages a collection of ControlAgentEvent instances within an observable, singleton pattern, supporting appending and clearing events.

classes.name: AgentEventStore
classes.description: A singleton class that stores and manages a list of ControlAgentEvent objects, with capacity control and observable behavior.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Adds a new ControlAgentEvent to the store and maintains the maximum number of stored events.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Removes all events from the store.
